title: Four edges
text: Slides in from the start, end, top, or bottom, in three sizes, mirrored in RTL.

title: Modal or not
text: Modal drawers make the page inert; non-modal ones let users keep working.

title: Cancelable close
text: Escape, backdrop, and close button raise a cancel event you can veto.

title: Footer actions
text: Action buttons close the drawer and report which one was pressed.
